announcements.content:

参与方式：
• 在 抖音 / 小红书 / B站 任一平台发布 SyncPan 相关原创内容（图文或视频）

• 审核通过后，1 个月 SVIP 发放到你的账号

en.title: 🎁 Post & Win: 1 Month SVIP Free
en.summary: Post about SyncPan on Douyin / Xiaohongshu / Bilibili and get 1 month of SVIP after review.
en.content:
SyncPan posting reward event is live!

How to join:
• Post original SyncPan-related content (article or video) on Douyin / Xiaohongshu / Bilibili
• Join our QQ group (945729782) and submit your post link + account username
• After review, 1 month of SVIP will be granted to your account

One participation per user. Content must be original.

announcements.title: 👋 欢迎使用 SyncPan
announcements.summary: 跨网盘文件同步工具，支持百度网盘和夸克网盘。
announcements.content:
感谢你使用 SyncPan。

SyncPan 可以帮助你：
• 在百度网盘和夸克网盘之间同步文件
• 设置定时任务，自动执行同步
• 管理多个网盘账号
• 批量传输和分享文件

如果你有建议或问题，欢迎随时反馈。

en.title: 👋 Welcome to SyncPan
en.summary: Cross-cloud file sync tool supporting Baidu Pan and Quark Pan.
en.content:
Thank you for using SyncPan.

SyncPan can help you:
• Sync files between Baidu Pan and Quark Pan
• Schedule automatic sync tasks
• Manage multiple cloud accounts
• Batch transfer and share files

If you have suggestions or encounter issues, feel free to provide feedback.
